categories.main_business_segments: TOHO Co., Ltd. operates four main business segments: Distributor (wholesale of food ingredients to the foodservice industry), Cash & Carry (cash-based wholesale stores for small foodservice operators), Food Solution (providing ASP sales, quality management, construction, equipment, and support services for foodservice businesses), and Food Supermarket (which was fully exited in November 2024). The core focus is on supplying food ingredients and related solutions to the restaurant and hospitality sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages an extensive logistics and distribution network, proprietary private brand (PB) product development, and quality assurance systems. It utilizes advanced IT/ASP systems for business support, efficient inventory and supply chain management, and offers high-performance commercial kitchen equipment, including imported and in-house manufactured machines. Quality and food safety are ensured through ISO certifications and dedicated quality assurance departments.
categories.primary_customers_markets: TOHO primarily serves the foodservice industry, including restaurants, hotels, theme parks, institutional catering, and small to medium-sized eateries. Its customer base also includes commercial kitchens, food retailers, and overseas Japanese food businesses, with a strong focus on supporting the operational needs of professional food operators.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operations are in Japan, with a particularly strong presence in western Japan and expanding bases in the Kanto region. Internationally, TOHO has subsidiaries in Singapore, Malaysia, and Hong Kong, targeting Japanese foodservice operators and local businesses in Southeast Asia and Greater China.
categories.supply_chain_position: TOHO operates primarily as a midstream distributor, sourcing food ingredients and products from manufacturers and suppliers, and delivering them directly to foodservice operators. It also engages in some upstream activities through private brand product development and limited manufacturing, as well as downstream activities via retail (Cash & Carry) and support services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening regional business models, expanding private brand offerings, growing the Cash & Carry and overseas businesses, and enhancing total support functions for foodservice operators. The company is investing in IT/DX (digital transformation), sustainability (including CO2 reduction and sustainable food development), and M&A to drive growth. R&D is focused on developing value-added, sustainable, and efficiency-enhancing food products and solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of food ingredients and related products to foodservice operators (both wholesale and retail), as well as through the provision of business support systems, equipment sales, and various foodservice solutions. Additional income streams include real estate leasing and construction services for food-related businesses.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: TOHO is positioned as one of Japan’s largest dedicated foodservice wholesalers, especially strong in the western regions and expanding in Kanto and overseas. Its main competitors include other national and regional food wholesalers and Cash & Carry chains. The company differentiates itself through its comprehensive support for foodservice operators and its private brand product development.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending January 2025, TOHO reported consolidated sales of 246.5 billion yen, with operating profit of 7.5 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent shareholders of 4.5 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady growth in sales and profitability in recent years, with a strong recovery post-pandemic and a focus on improving capital efficiency (ROE 15.5%). The exit from the supermarket business is expected to further concentrate resources on core growth areas.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TOHO’s value proposition lies in its ability to provide comprehensive, one-stop solutions for foodservice operators, including high-quality, safe, and sustainable food ingredients, operational support systems, and efficiency-enhancing equipment. The company emphasizes its private brand products, tailored solutions for labor shortages and operational efficiency, and its commitment to food safety, sustainability, and customer-centric service.
